value.rationale: The published problem of statistical dependence between smoothness and blocking has a naturally meaningful small-field exact case at degree five, the genus-six plane-quintic stratum. The conditional probability differs by about fifteen percentage points from the unconditional half rate; the ten complete rational-subset strata distinguish Fano-line geometry even at fixed rational-point count. This is a complete incidence classification, not an arbitrary small increment or a restatement of previously published total genus-six counts.
